_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the cartographer at home (hub_cartographer): who is still held; Liora foreshadowed.

text.zh_TW: 製圖師：「要看看我的地圖嗎？」
製圖師：「你爹娘被帶往更上面——門樓那邊。還有好多王都的人。對了……塔頂的窗戶邊，常有個穿白裙的女孩在唱歌。」
text.en: Cartographer: "Your parents were taken further up, toward the gatehouse. Lots of people from the capital too. Oh, and... a girl in a white dress often sings at a window at the very top."
